Result of the Special Board Meeting

At the Special Meeting of the Board of Directors of the Registrant held on 15 July 2025, at which meeting a quorum was present and acting throughout, the following matters were discussed:1. Resignation of Bienvenido A. Tan III as Chairman and President and Election of Mr. Carlos G. Dominguez as new Director, Chairman and President; and2. Resolutions authorizing the Corporation to update its bank signatories.
